qe: On the 16th Kartik, the day after Dewali, the Goalas of the Patna district observed which festival by driving their cattle over a pig with its feet tied?
qh: दीवाली के अगले दिन, कार्तिक की 16 तारीख को पटना जिले के गोअला लोग किस पर्व को मनाते थे, जिसमें वे अपने पशुओं को बँधे पैरों वाले सूअर के ऊपर दौड़ाते थे?
e: Patna jile ke Goalas yaani Ahir samuday me pashuon ka bahut mahatva tha, isliye unke ek khaas tyohar me pashu tatha doodh dono shamil hote the. Isi samuday me Kartik sudi 16, yaani Dewali ke agle din, ek anokha parishram manaya jaata tha, jise Gaidarh ya Sohrai ke naam se jaana jaata tha. Iski vidhi is tarah thi - Dewali ki raat ghar me bachi hui saari doolh me chawal ubal kar khir banayi jaati thi tatha woh khir Basawan naam ke dev ko arpit ki jaati thi. Us raat sabhi pashuon ko bina khane ke chhod diya jaata tha; agli subah unke seengh laal rang se range jaate the tatha shareer par laal chhinte lagai jaati thin. Uske baad pashuon ko ek khet me chhoda jaata tha, jahan pehle se ek suar is tarah baandh diya jaata tha ki uske pair aapas me bane hue the; pashu us bechare jaanvar ko kuchal kar tatha seengh maar kar maarte the. Exam point: Goalas 16 Kartik, yaani Dewali ke agle din, Gaidarh ya Sohrai manate the; us raat doolh me ubla chawal yaani khir Basawan dev ko chadha kar pashuon ko bhookha rakha jaata tha; agli subah unke seengh laal rang kar bandhe pairon wale suar ke upar daudaya jaata tha.

qe: The Kurmis of the Patna district worshipped Muhammadan Panch Pir, and the officiating priest of this worship was a man of which caste?
qh: पटना जिले के कुर्मी मुस्लिम पंच पीर की पूजा करते थे, तथा इस पूजा के पुजारी किस जाति के होते थे?
e: Patna jile ke Kurmi samuday ki dharmik manyataon me ek ajeeb tarah ka mila-jula roop dikhta tha. Is samuday ke log ek taraf Hanuman tatha Kali jaise orthodox devi-devtaon ki puja karte the, tatha doosri taraf muhammadan Panch Pir ki bhi puja karte the. Is Panch Pir ki puja me purohit ka kaam Dafali jati ka vyakti karta tha, jo dafali baja kar tatha anya rasm kar ke puja sampann karata tha; yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur ke lok-dharm me Hindu tatha Musalman dono paramparaon ka sampark aam baat thi. Isi samuday me kai tarah ke pret yaani evil spirits tatha deviyon ki puja bhi hoti thi, jinme Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur ke naam pramukh the. Aise mishrit vishwas dikhate hain ki gaon ka dharm shastriy niyamon se zyada ritiyon tatha paramparaon par chalta tha. Exam point: Kurmis Panch Pir ki puja karte the tatha unke purohit Dafali jati ke hote the; isi samuday me Hanuman tatha Kali ke saath Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur jaise prem ki puja bhi hoti thi; ise dekh kar lok-dharm me Hindu tatha Musalman paramparaon ka mila-jula roop saaf hota hai.

qe: Which spirit worshipped in the Patna district was regarded as benevolent, unlike the others?
qh: पटना जिले में पूजी जाने वाली आत्माओं में किसे अन्य की भाँति भयावह नहीं, बल्कि परोपकारी माना जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke Kurmi samuday me pret yaani evil spirits tatha devi-devtaon ki ek lambi suchi pracharit thi. Inme zyadatar aatmaayein bhayavah tatha nuksan pahunchane wali maani jaati thin - jaise Goraiya, jise gaon ke bahar mitti ke tile par puja jaata tha, tatha Ram Thakur, jise bakre ki bali se shaant kiya jaata tha. Lekin ek aatma aisi thi jo pareshan karne wali nahi, balki paropkari maani jaati thi - woh thi Bandi Mai. Isi samuday me Karta naam ki ek aur aatma ki puja hoti thi, jiska koi murti ya drishya nahi tha tatha jiske naam se lagta tha ki yah srishti ko banane wale tatha is brahmand ke rachayita ka roop hai. Aise vishwas dikhate hain ki us daur ke lok-dharm me bhay tatha shraddha dono saath-saath chalte the. Exam point: Kurmi samuday me Bandi Mai ko paropkari yaani benevolent aatma mana jaata tha; Goraiya tatha Ram Thakur jaise pret bhayavah maane jaate the tatha unhe bali se shaant kiya jaata tha; Karta aatma ki koi murti nahi thi aur use srishti ko banane wale ka roop maana jaata tha.

qe: In cases of illness, what did the ojhas do with the spirit they believed to have possessed a person?
qh: बीमारी के मामलों में ओझा, व्यक्ति में घुसी मानी जाने वाली आत्मा का क्या करते थे?
oe: They tied it to a tree
They sent it to a temple
They imprisoned it in a bamboo tube or earthen pot which was burnt or buried
They fed it with rice and milk
oh: वे उसे पेड़ से बाँध देते थे
वे उसे मंदिर भेज देते थे
वे उसे बाँस की पोर या मिट्टी के बर्तन में कैद करके जला या दबा देते थे
e: Patna jile ke gaon me bimari ko aksar pret yaani evil spirit ka kaam maana jaata tha, isliye ilaj ke liye ojha yaani jhaad-phook karne wale ko bulaya jaata tha. Ojha apne ek sahayak pret ki shakti se us pret ko bhagane ka daava karta tha; jab pret shareer se bahar nikalta tha, to ojha use ek chhoti baans ki por ya mitti ke ghade me kaid kar deta tha tatha us por ya ghade ko jala diya jaata tha ya zameen me daba diya jaata tha. Aise vishwas me bhay ke saath-saath lok-dharm ki paramparaon ka prabhav saaf dikhta tha, kyunki aisi manyataon me bimari ko kisi bahari shakti ka parinaam maana jaata tha. Isi kaaran gaon me ojha tatha sayana ka darja bada tha tatha log ilaj ke liye unhi ke paas jaate the. Exam point: bimari ko pret yaani evil spirit ka kaam maana jaata tha tatha ilaj ke liye ojha bulaye jaate the; ojha apne sahayak pret ki shakti se pret ko bhaga kar use baans ki por ya mitti ke ghade me kaid karta tha tatha use jala ya daba diya jaata tha.

qe: Which spirit was most feared as the spirit of a woman who had died in child-birth, and needles were driven into the ground to pacify her?
qh: जिस स्त्री की प्रसव के समय मृत्यु हो गई हो, उसकी आत्मा के रूप में किससे सबसे अधिक भय रखा जाता था, तथा उसे शांत करने के लिए जमीन में सुइयाँ गाड़ी जाती थीं?
e: Gaon ke lok-vishwas me pret yaani evil spirits ki ek alag duniya thi tatha unme sabse zyada bhay Churail ka tha. Churail us stri ki aatma maani jaati thi jiski mrityu prasav yaani bacche ke janm ke samay hui ho. Use shaant karne ke liye zameen me sui yaani needles gaad di jaati thin tatha yah manyata thi ki isse woh ghar-parivar ko pareshan nahi karegi. Isi tarah in vishwaso me yah bhi shamil tha ki agar koi stri prasav ke dauran mare, to uske paanv me sui chubhoi jaati thin tatha uske shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dali jaati thi, taaki woh apne parivar ko dhoondhti phirti na rahe. Aisi manyataayein dikhati hain ki us samay mrityu tatha prem ko kaise samjha jaata tha tatha auraton ki maut ke aas-paas kitna bhay tatha andhvishwas tha. Exam point: Churail us stri ki aatma maani jaati thi jiski maut prasav ke samay hui ho; use shaant karne ke liye zameen me sui gaadi jaati thi; prasav me mari stri ke paanv me sui chubhone tatha shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dalne ki parampara thi.

qe: When a woman died in child-birth, what was thrown on her body to prevent her haunting her family?
qh: जब किसी स्त्री की प्रसव के समय मृत्यु होती थी, तो परिवार को न छूने के लिए उसके शरीर पर क्या डाला जाता था?
e: Gaon ke lok-vishwas me pret yaani aatmaon ka bahut mahatva tha tatha unhe shaant karne ke alag-alag upay pracharit the. Kurmi samuday me yah manyata thi ki jis stri ki mrityu prasav yaani bacche ke janm ke samay hui ho, woh Churail ban kar apne hi ghar-parivar ko pareshan karti hai. Isse bachne ke liye uske paanv me sui yaani needles chubhoi jaati thin tatha uske shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dali jaati thi. Vichaar yah tha ki aise upay se woh aatma ghar ki hadd me nahi rahegi tatha apne logon ko dhoondhne nahi aa sakegi. Isi ke saath in samudayon me Bandi Mai jaisi paropkari aatma ki puja bhi hoti thi, jise log shubh maante the. Exam point: prasav me mari stri ke paanv me sui chubhone tatha shareer par ret tatha urid yaani dhanse ki dal dalne ki parampara thi, taaki woh Churail ban kar parivar ko pareshan na kare; isi tarah Bandi Mai jaisi aatma ko paropkari maana jaata tha.

qe: Beside the revenue servants, who among the ordinary village officials performed important ceremonial functions at weddings and funerals?
qh: राजस्व-कर्मचारियों के अलावा गाँव के साधारण अधिकारियों में कौन विवाह तथा मृत्यु के अवसर पर महत्वपूर्ण रस्में निभाता था?
e: Patna jile ke gaon me revenue ke adhikariyon ke alava kuch aise karmchari the jo gaon ke rozana ke kaam tatha rasmon me zaruri the. Inme hajjam yaani nai ka naam alag tha, kyunki woh apne paramparagat kaam ke saath-saath vivah tatha mrityu jaisi rasmon me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhata tha; in maukon par uski upasthiti zaruri maani jaati thi. Baaki karmchariyon me badhai yaani carpenter tatha lohar shamil the, jo kheti ke auzaar yaani hal, khurpi tatha hathyar banane tatha unki marammat ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha, tatha chamar ki patni gaon me dai yaani midwife ka kaam karti thi. Is tarah gaon ek aisi vyavastha thi jisme kai peshe apne kaam se bane hue the tatha lagbhag sabhi aavashyaktaon ki poori gaon me hi ho jaati thi. Exam point: vivah tatha mrityu ki rasmon me hajjam yaani nai ki upasthiti mahatvapurn maani jaati thi; badhai tatha lohar kheti ke auzaar banane tatha theek karne ke liye zaruri the; dhobi kapde dhota tha tatha dai ka kaam chamar ki patni karti thi.

qe: Approximately what proportion of the population of the Patna district spoke Magahi?
qh: पटना जिले की जनसंख्या का लगभग कितना हिस्सा मगही बोलता था?
e: Patna jile me bolchal ki mukhya bhasha Magahi thi tatha ise bolne wale logon ki sankhya bahut zyada thi. Jile ki kul abaadi ka lagbhag chhiyanave pratishat log Magahi bolte the, yaani yah kaha ja sakta hai ki jile ka poora aam jeevan isi boli me chalta tha. Isi kaaran sarkari kaam tatha adalat me likhit bhasha alag hone par bhi aam logon ka sampark Magahi se hi hota tha. Us samay likhne ke liye Kaithi lipi ka istemal aam tha tatha padhe-likhe log Devanagari lipi bhi kaam me lete the; saath hi shaharon ki Mussalman abaadi Urdu bolti thi tatha likhne ke liye Persian lipi kaam me leti thi. Aise aankde dikhate hain ki ek hi jile me boli tatha lipi ke kai roop saath-saath chalte the. Exam point: Patna jile ki lagbhag chhiyanave pratishat abaadi Magahi bolti thi; likhne me Kaithi lipi aam thi tatha padhe-likhe log Devanagari bhi istemal karte the; shaharon ki Mussalman abaadi Urdu bolti thi tatha Persian lipi likhti thi.

qe: Which script was in general use for writing Magahi in the Patna district?
qh: पटना जिले में मगही लिखने के लिए सामान्य रूप से कौन-सी लिपि प्रयोग की जाती थी?
e: Patna jile me bolchal ki bhasha Magahi thi, lekin uske likhne ki apni riti alag thi. Us samay aam roop se likhne ke liye Kaithi lipi ka istemal hota tha, kyunki yah lipi vyavharik likha-kajja tatha hisab-kitab ke liye aasan maani jaati thi. Iske alava padhe-likhe yaani educated log Devanagari lipi bhi istemal karte the; is tarah ek hi samay me do lipiyan kaam me aati thin. Isi jile me Mussalman abaadi Urdu bolti thi tatha likhne ke liye Persian lipi kaam me leti thi, tatha Bangali tatha Marwari vyapari apni-apni boli ka istemal karte the. Aisi baatein dikhati hain ki us daur me bhasha tatha lipi ka chunav kaam tatha samuday ke hisaab se hota tha. Exam point: Magahi likhne ke liye aam taur par Kaithi lipi ka istemal hota tha; padhe-likhe log Devanagari lipi bhi kaam me lete the; Urdu ke liye Persian lipi tatha shahar ke anya vyapari apni-apni boli ka istemal karte the.

qe: Magahi had no old literature of its own, but which long narrative songs recited by strolling bards were known over the whole of Northern India?
qh: मगही का अपना प्राचीन साहित्य नहीं था, परंतु घुमंतू भाटों द्वारा गाई जाने वाली कौन-सी लंबी वीरगाथाएँ पूरे उत्तर भारत में जानी जाती थीं?
oe: The song of Alha and Udal
The song of Reshma and Chuharmal
The song of Gopichand and Bharthari only
The song of Lorik and the song of Gopichandra
oh: केवल गोपीचंद तथा भरथरी का गीत
लोरिक का गीत तथा गोपीचंद का गीत
e: Magahi boli ka apna koi purana likhit sahitya nahi tha, lekin is kshetra me gaanon tatha vachik kathaon ki parampara bahut samriddh thi. Yahan ke logon me kai lok-geet pracharit the tatha ghoomte-firte bhaat tatha charan lambe-lambe vira-gathon ka vachan karte the. Inme do geet khaas taur par mashhoor the - Lorik naam ke gowala nayak ki katha tatha Gopichandra ki katha; ye dono kathayein uttar bharat ke bade hisse me kam-zyada gyaat thin. Lorik ki katha me ek gowala nayak ke sahas tatha prem ka varnan milta hai, isliye woh gaon-gaon me gaayi jaati thi. Is tarah dikhta hai ki jahan likhit sahitya nahi tha, wahan mukh se parampara chalti thi tatha logon ki bhavnaayein tatha itihas inhi geeton me sajiv rahte the. Exam point: Magahi ka purana likhit sahitya nahi tha, lekin vachik lok-geet tatha bhaaton dwara gaayi jaane wali vira-gathayein pracharit thin; inme Lorik naam ke gowala nayak ki katha tatha Gopichandra ki katha uttar bharat bhar me gyaat thin.

qe: What habit of Magahi, used in addressing a person with respect in this region, gave the men of Magadh a reputation for rudeness elsewhere?
qh: इस क्षेत्र में किसी को आदर से संबोधित करने के लिए प्रयुक्त मगही की कौन-सी आदत मगध के लोगों को बाहर कठोर कहलाने का कारण बनी?
oe: Adding the word 're' to the name of a person held in respect
Dropping the name of the person addressed
oh: आदरणीय व्यक्ति के नाम के साथ 'रे' शब्द लगाना
बड़ों के लिए बहुवचन का प्रयोग
संबोधित व्यक्ति का नाम छोड़ देना
हर व्यक्ति को 'आप' कहकर संबोधित करना
e: Magahi boli ki ek khaas pahchaan uske sambodhan ke tareeke se judi thi. Is ilake me jab kisi vyakti ka samman karna hota tha, to uske naam ke saath 're' shabd lagaya jaata tha; yaani yahi shabd yahan aadar ka chinh tha. Lekin bharat ke anya bhaagon me yahi shabd sirf chhote ya niche darje wale vyakti ko pukarne ya usse ghrina jatane ke liye use hota tha. Isi kaaran Magadh ke logon ko bharat ke anya kshetron ke log rude yaani kathor tatha asabhya maanne lage, tatha yah baat itni pracharit hui ki ek lok-geet me is par bahut haansi udai gayi, jisme ek Magahi vyakti ko isi aadat ke kaaran bekaar ki pitai sahni padti hai. Is tarah bhasha ke ek chhote se prayog ne poore kshetra ke logon ki chhavi bana di. Exam point: Magahi me samman jatane ke liye vyakti ke naam ke saath 're' shabd lagaya jaata tha; anya kshetron me yahi shabd chhote ya niche darje ke liye istemal hota tha, isliye Magadh ke logon ko kathor maana jaane laga; is baat ka jikr ek lok-geet me bhi milta hai.

qe: In the interior of the Patna district, which dialect of Eastern Hindi was used by Musalmans and Kayasths, and also as a language of politeness when addressing Europeans?
qh: पटना जिले के भीतरी भागों में मुसलमान तथा कायस्थ दोनों किस पूर्वी हिंदी की बोली का प्रयोग करते थे, जिसे यूरोपियनों से बात करते समय शिष्टता की भाषा भी माना जाता था?
e: Patna jile me Magahi aam bolchal ki bhasha thi, lekin jile ke andaruni ilakon me ek aur boli ka istemal bhi hota tha. Wahan Mussalman tatha Kayasth dono mil kar Awadhi boli bolte the, jo poorvi Hindi ki ek boli hai. Isi boli ka ek doosra istemal bhi tha - jab gaon ke saral log yuropiyon se baat karte the, to woh bhi Awadhi ka sahaara lete the, kyunki unhe lagta tha ki yahi shisht samaj ki bhasha hai. Aisa asar unhe shahar tatha kasbon ke apne Mussalman mitron se mila tha. Is tarah ek hi jile me Magahi, Awadhi tatha Urdu teen tarah ki boliyaan ek saath chalti thin tatha har boli ka apna samajik istemal tha. Exam point: Patna jile ke andaruni hisson me Mussalman tatha Kayasth Awadhi bolte the; gaon ke log yuropiyon se baat karte samay Awadhi ko shisht bhasha maan kar istemal karte the; is tarah jile me Magahi, Awadhi tatha Urdu teeno pracharit thin.

qe: Bengali was spoken in the Patna district by Bengalis settled in Patna and Bankipore who were chiefly engaged in which work?
qh: पटना जिले में पटना तथा बांकीपुर में बसे बंगाली बंगला बोलते थे, जो मुख्यतः किस काम में लगे हुए थे?
e: Patna jile me sirf ek bhasha nahi chalti thi; shahar tatha kasbon me alag-alag samudayon ki apni-apni boliyaan sunai deti thin. Patna tatha Bankipore me base Bangali log Bangla bolte the tatha unka kaam mukhya roop se daftar ka likha-padhi, sarkari naukri tatha chhoti dukanen chalana tha; isliye unka sampark shahar ke prashasan tatha vyapar dono se tha. Isi tarah Patna shahar ke kapde ke bazaar, khaas taur par Chauk Kalan naam ke vyaparik ilake me, Marwari boli bolne wale bahut se kapde ke vyapari rahte the. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki us daur me Patna ek aisa shahar tha jahan kshetra ke bahar se aaye vyapari tatha karmchari apni bhasha tatha pehchaan ke saath base hue the. Exam point: Patna tatha Bankipore me base Bangali log Bangla bolte the tatha ve mukhya roop se daftar-kaam, sarkari naukri tatha dukanen chalate the; Patna ke Chauk Kalan ilake me Marwari boli bolne wale kapde ke vyapari zyada the; is tarah shahar me kai bhashaayein saath-saath pracharit thin.

qe: In which commercial quarter of Patna city did Marwari cloth merchants chiefly carry on their trade?
qh: पटना नगर के किस व्यापारिक मोहल्ले में मारवाड़ी कपड़ा-व्यापारी मुख्यतः अपना व्यापार करते थे?
e: Patna shahar us daur me ek bada vyaparik kendra ban chuka tha, jahan door-door se vyapari aate the. Inme bahut se aise vyapari the jinki boli Marwari thi tatha jo kapde ka vyapar karte the; unka mukhya vyaparik ilaka shahar ka Chauk Kalan naam ka mohalla tha. Yah baat is baat ki gawah hai ki shahar ke bazaar sirf sthanik kisanon tatha karigaron ke nahi, balki bahari puraji tatha bahari bhasha ke vyapariyon ke bhi the. Unke alava Patna tatha Bankipore me base Bangali log daftar ka kaam, sarkari naukri tatha dukanen chalate the. Is tarah Patna ka vyaparik jeevan kai bhashaon tatha samudayon ke milne ka kendra ban gaya, jisse uski pehchaan bade bazaar wale shahar ke roop me bani. Exam point: Patna shahar ke Chauk Kalan ilake me Marwari boli bolne wale kapde ke vyapari mukhya roop se vyapar karte the; Patna tatha Bankipore me Bangali log daftar-kaam tatha dukanen chalate the; is tarah shahar ka vyaparik jeevan kai bhashaon ke mel se bana tha.

qe: The tomb of which saint at Bihar Sharif was held in special veneration, the Muhammadans assembling there at the anniversary of his death on the fifth of Shawwal?
qh: बिहारशरीफ़ में किस संत की मज़ार विशेष रूप से पूजनीय मानी जाती थी, जहाँ मुसलमान उनकी मृत्यु की वर्षगाँठ पर शव्वाल की पाँचवीं तारीख़ को इकट्ठे होते थे?
e: Bihar me do prasiddh dargah thi - Mallik Ibrahim Bayu ki tatha Hazrat Makhdum Shah Sharif-ud-din ki. In dono me se Shah Sharif-ud-din ki mazar vishesh roop se pujya maani jaati thi. Dargah ka matlab hai kisi pir ya sant ki mazaar, jise log tirth-sthal ki tarah maante hain. Log wahan bimaari se mukti paane, dushit aatmaon ko bhagane ya apni mannat poori hone ki aasha se pahunchte the. Shah Sharif-ud-din ki mrityu ki varshgath par log Bihar me bade jamavde ke saath ikatthe hote the; yah tareekh Shawwal mahine ki paanchvin thi. Islamic calendar chandrama par aadharit hai, isliye ye tareekhein angreji mahino ke hisaab se har saal badalti rehti hain. Exam point: Bihar me Shah Sharif-ud-din ki mazar vishesh pujya thi tatha unki varshgath Shawwal ki paanchvin tareekh ko manai jaati thi; dargah bimaari, dushit aatmaon tatha mannat ke liye logon ka tirth-sthal tha.

qe: Two dargahs at Jethuli were places of pilgrimage, and a fair was held there on which date?
qh: जेठुली में दो दरगाहें तीर्थ-स्थल थीं तथा वहाँ मेला किस तारीख़ को लगता था?
e: Jethuli me Shihab-ud-din Jagjant tatha Shah Adam Sufi ki dargah thi tatha dono hi sthal logon ke liye ziyarat yaani darshan ke kendra the. Wahin Zikad mahine ki ikkisvin tareekh ko mela lagta tha. Aise dargah-mela par aas-paas ke Hindu tatha Mussalman dono samuday ke log aate the. Melon ka aayojan sirf dharm se juda nahi hota tha; ye karobar, milne-milane tatha samudayik samanvay ke bade avsar bhi hote the, jahan mithai, kapde tatha kheti ke saaman ki chhoti-chhoti dukanein lagti thin. Islamic mahine chandrama ke hisaab se chakkar karte hain, isliye Zikad ki ikkisvin tareekh angreji calendar me har saal ek nayi tareekh par aati hai. Exam point: Jethuli me Shihab-ud-din Jagjant tatha Shah Adam Sufi ki dargah mashhur tirth-sthal thi tatha wahan Zikad mahine ki ikkisvin tareekh ko mela lagta tha, jisme Hindu tatha Muslim dono shamil hote the.

qe: Besides the shrines of the four Pirs named Mansur, Maruf, Jafar and Mahdi, which shrine in Patna was the site of another large Muhammadan gathering?
qh: मंसूर, मारूफ़, जाफ़र तथा महदी नामक चार पीरों के मज़ारों के अलावा पटना में कौन-सा मज़ार एक और बड़े मुस्लिम जमावड़े का स्थल था?
oe: The shrine of Shah Adam Sufi
The dargah of Mallik Ibrahim Bayu
e: Patna shahar me Mansur, Maruf, Jafar tatha Mahdi naam ke char piron ke mazaar the, jo logon ke liye pujya sthal the. In charon ke alawa Shah Arzani ka mazaar bhi Patna me ek bade jamavde ka sthal tha. Pir ka matlab hai sufi sant, tatha unke mazaar dargah kehlate hain. Log in mazaron par bimaari se changa hone, dushit aatmaon se chhutkara paane ya apni mannat poori hone ki aasha me pahunchte the. In mazaron ke aas-paas mahine ki kuch tareekhon par chhoti-chhoti mela-jaisi bheed bhi lagi rehti thi, jisse Patna shahar ka mazar-jeevan jeevit bana rahta tha. Exam point: Patna shahar me char pir - Mansur, Maruf, Jafar tatha Mahdi - tatha unke alawa Shah Arzani ka mazaar bhi ek bade jamavde ka sthal tha; yah mazaar aise sthal the jahan log bimaari tatha mannat ke liye aate the.

qe: At Maner two melas were held every year; one on the anniversary of Makhdum Yahia's death and the other in commemoration of which event?
qh: मानेर में हर वर्ष दो मेले लगते थे; एक मख़दूम याहिया की मृत्यु की वर्षगाँठ पर तथा दूसरा किस घटना के स्मरण में?
oe: The arrival of the saint from Bihar Sharif
e: Maner me Makhdum Yahia tatha Shah Daulat ki mazarein thi tatha wahan har saal do mele lagte the. Pehla mela Makhdum Yahia ki mrityu ki varshgath par hota tha tatha doosra mela Ghazi Mian ke vivah ki smriti me. Ghazi Mian ki veerta ki katha jile bhar me phaili hui thi, isliye unke naam ka mela jile ke sabse bade varshik jamavdon me gina jaata tha. Yah mela Maner ke talaab ke kinare lagta tha tatha isme mukhyatah nimn varg ke Hindu tatha Mussalman shamil hote the. Aise melon me toddy yaani tadi ki khapat bahut zyada hoti thi tatha sangeet ke saath shobha-yatra nikalti thi. Exam point: Maner me har saal do mele - ek Makhdum Yahia ki mrityu ki varshgath par, doosra Ghazi Mian ke vivah ki smriti me - lagte the; Ghazi Mian ka mela Maner talaab ke kinare jile ke sabse bade jamavdon me tha.

qe: Ghazi Mian, whose fair at Maner was one of the greatest annual gatherings of the district, was the nephew of which ruler and is said to have been killed near Bahraich at the age of nineteen?
qh: ग़ाज़ी मियाँ, जिनके नाम का मेला मानेर में जिले के सबसे बड़े वार्षिक जमावड़ों में गिना जाता था, किस शासक के भतीजे थे तथा बहराइच के पास उन्नीस वर्ष की आयु में मारे गए बताए जाते हैं?
e: Ghazi Mian ko is jile me bade shraddha se yaad kiya jaata tha. Kaha jaata tha ki woh Ghazni ke Mahmud ke bhatije the tatha Oudh par hue shuruati aakraman ka netritva unhone kiya tha. Bahut veerta dikhane ke baad 1034 Isvi me Bahraich ke paas hui ek ladaai me woh mare gaye, jab unki umar keval unnis saal thi. Unhe Bharat me Islam ke pehle shahidon me gina jaata hai tatha woh javani tatha ladakpan bhari veerta ke pratik maane jaate hain. Isi vajah se unke naam ka mela bahut bada hota tha tatha usme sabhi vargon ke log shamil hote the. Exam point: Ghazi Mian Ghazni ke Mahmud ke bhatije bataye jaate hain; 1034 Isvi me Bahraich ke paas unnis saal ki umar me unki mrityu hui tatha unhe Bharat me Islam ke pehle shahidon me gina jaata hai.

qe: In the mock marriage procession of the Ghazi Mian fair at Maner, earthen pitchers filled with toddy were carried along with banners known by what name?
qh: मानेर के ग़ाज़ी मियाँ मेले की नक़ली बारात में ताड़ी से भरे मिट्टी के घड़े किन नाम के झंडों के साथ ले जाए जाते थे?
e: Ghazi Mian ke mela ka ek mukhya aakarshan nakli baraat thi, jo shahar se talaab ke kinare tak jaati thi. Is baraat me log mitti ke woh ghade saath le jaate the jinme tadi bhari hoti thi, tatha Ghazi Mian ka danda kahlane wale jhande bhi sang chalte the; saath me sangeet tatha shobha-yatra hoti thi. Tadi ek madira-padarth hai, jo khajoor ya palm ke ped ke tane se nikalta hai tatha gaon me aam tha. Us samay ke varnan me is mele ko bacchanalian yaani masti-bhare utsav jaisa bataya gaya hai, jisme tadi ki khapat bahut zyada hoti thi. Melon me is tarah ki nakli baraat lok-parampara ka rochak pehlu dikhati hai. Exam point: nakli baraat me tadi se bhare mitti ke ghade tatha Ghazi Mian ka danda kahlane wale jhande le jaaye jaate the; yah baraat shahar se talaab tak sangeet ke saath jaati thi tatha usme tadi ki khapat bahut hoti thi.

qe: On the morning of the Maner mela, women believed to be possessed by devils prostrated before a shrine east of the rest-house; how were they brought round?
qh: मानेर मेले की सुबह डाक-बंगले के पूर्व की ओर बने मज़ार के सामने भूत-प्रेत के कब्जे में मानी जाने वाली स्त्रियाँ साष्टांग प्रणाम करती थीं; उन्हें होश में लाने का तरीक़ा क्या था?
oe: A toddy-filled pitcher was placed before them
They were fanned with a nim twig
Incense was applied to their nostrils
Cold water was sprinkled on their faces
oh: उनके सामने ताड़ी भरा घड़ा रखा जाता था
उन्हें नीम की टहनी से हवा दी जाती थी
उनकी नाक के छिद्रों पर धूप दी जाती थी
उनके चेहरे पर ठंडा पानी छिड़का जाता था
e: Maner mela ki subah ek ajeeb drishya dikhta tha. Jo striyaan tatha ladkiyan dushit aatmaon ke kabze me maani jaati thin, woh mazar ke saamne saashtang pranam karti thin. Uttejit hokar woh behosh ho jaati thin; is avastha ko hysteria ya catalepsy jaisi sthiti maana jaata tha. Phir unki naak ke chhidron par dhup yaani incense di jaati thi tatha woh hosh me aa jaati thin. Gaon ke log is badlav ko mazar ki chamatkari shakti ka parinaam maante the tatha kehte the ki yah mazar dushit aatmaon ko bhaga sakti hai. Aisi manyataon me bimari tatha mansik tanav ko bhi dharmik roop diya jaata tha. Exam point: mela ki subah kabze wali maani jaane wali striyaan mazar ke saamne pranam karke behosh ho jaati thin tatha unki naak ke chhidron par dhup dene par woh hosh me aa jaati thin; ise mazar ki chamatkari shakti maana jaata tha.

qe: Which community of the district claimed descent from Saiyid Ibrahim Bayu, whose tomb stands on the Pirpahari hill at Bihar and who, as a general, planted garrisons in its villages?
qh: जिले का कौन-सा समुदाय स्वयं को सैयद इब्राहिम बायू का वंशज मानता था, जिनकी मज़ार बिहार की पीरपहाड़ी पर है तथा जिन्होंने सेनापति के रूप में गाँवों में सैनिक चौकियाँ बसाई थीं?
e: Is jile ke Mallik apne aap ko Saiyid Ibrahim Bayu ka vanshaj maante the. Kaha jaata tha ki woh Ala-ud-din Ghori ke senapati the tatha desh ke is bhaag me bagee karne walon ko dabaane ke liye bheje gaye the. Unhone kai gaonon me sainik chaukiyan banaayin tatha unke sainik wahan Hindu striyon se vivah kar ke bas gaye, jisse ek naya samuday khada hua. Unki shandar jeeton ke karan unhe Mallik ki upadhi mili tatha aage chalkar yah naam unke tatha unke sainikon dwara basaaye samuday par lagu ho gaya. Ibrahim Bayu ki mazar Bihar ki Pirpahari pahadi par hai, jo ek mashhur tirth-sthal hai tatha jahan log ziyarat ke liye aate hain. Exam point: Mallik samuday Saiyid Ibrahim Bayu ko apna purvaj maanta tha, jo Ala-ud-din Ghori ke senapati the; unhone gaonon me chaukiyan basayin tatha unki mazar Bihar ki Pirpahari pahadi par hai.

qe: In the popular religion of the Patna district, why did the ordinary villager make periodical offerings to evil spirits and godlings more carefully than to the regular Hindu gods?
qh: पटना जिले के लोक-धर्म में साधारण गाँववाला नियमित हिंदू देवताओं की तुलना में दुष्ट आत्माओं तथा देवियों को अधिक सावधानी से प्रसाद क्यों चढ़ाता था?
oe: Because they were the gods of the zamindar
Because the king had made it compulsory
Because the Brahman priest ordered him to do so
Because these spirits were believed to cause illness in the family and sickness among the cattle
oh: क्योंकि वे ज़मींदार के देवता थे
क्योंकि राजा ने इसे अनिवार्य कर दिया था
क्योंकि ब्राह्मण पुरोहित उसे ऐसा करने का आदेश देता था
क्योंकि ये आत्माएँ परिवार में बीमारी तथा पशुओं में रोग लाने वाली मानी जाती थीं
e: Patna jile ke lok-dharm me orthodox Hindu devi-devtaon ke saath-saath aisi aatmaayen tatha deviyaan bhi puja jaati thin, jo kisi dharm-granth ka hissa nahi thin. Aam gaonwala in aatmaon tatha deviyon ko prasann karne ka zyada dhyan rakhta tha, kyunki manyata yah thi ki yadi unhe prasann na kiya jaye, to woh parivar me bimari tatha pashuon me rog la deti hain. Ve apne purvajon ke samay se inki puja karta aaya tha. Inka asar kisano ke rozana ke jeevan par niyamit devtaon se bhi zyada seedha padta tha, isliye ashikshit Hindu tatha kuch agyaan Mussalman bhi unhe samay-samay par prasad chadhaate the. Ve orthodox devtaon ki suchi ka hissa nahi thin, lekin gaon ke logon ne unhe apne tareeke se devtaon ka darja de diya tha. Exam point: gaon ke log dushit aatmaon tatha deviyon ko zyada dhyan se prasann karte the, kyunki unhe parivar ki bimari tatha pashuon ke rog ka kaaran maana jaata tha; yah puja purvajon ke samay se chali aa rahi thi; inhe orthodox devtaon ka hissa na maankar bhi log unhe devtaon ka darja dete the.

qe: In the popular worship of the Patna district, fresh gold or silver coins were added to the altar of which kindly goddess at every marriage, and when they grew many they were strung into a necklace for the bridegroom?
qh: पटना जिले की लोक-पूजा में किस दयालु देवी की वेदी पर हर विवाह के अवसर पर सोने या चाँदी के नए सिक्के चढ़ाए जाते थे, तथा संख्या बढ़ने पर उन्हें पिरोकर वर के गले में डाला जाता था?
e: Patna jile ke lok-dharm me zyadatar aatmaayein dushit tatha darane wali maani jaati thin, lekin is beech ek devi aisi bhi thi jise bahut dyaalu maana jaata tha - woh Kurmi samuday ki devi Bandi Mai thi, jiske baare me kaha jaata tha ki woh kisi par jaldi krodhit nahi hoti. Uske liye bakre, pue yaani cakes tatha mithai chadhai jaati thi; tatha kai gaon me mitti ke us tile par, jo uski vedi ka kaam karta tha, sone ya chandi ka ek sikka rakha jaata tha. Har vivah ke samay us tile par naya sikka chadhaaya jaata tha; jab sikke itne ho jaate the ki sankhya badh jaati, to unhe dhaage me piron kar mala banai jaati thi tatha woh mala bhagyawan var ke gale me pahnai jaati thi. Aisi lok-riti dikhati hai ki gaon ke log apni khushiyon tatha aashirwad ko devi ki vedi par jama kiye sikko se joda karte the. Exam point: Kurmi samuday ki devi Bandi Mai ko bahut dyaalu maana jaata tha; uske liye bakre, pue tatha mithai chadhaaye jaate the tatha mitti ke tile par sone ya chandi ka sikka rakha jaata tha; har vivah par naya sikka chadhne se sikko ki mala banti thi, jo var ke gale me pahnai jaati thi.

qe: Which newly deified spirit of the Patna district is said to have come into existence about seventy years before the account was written, after possessing a villager and demanding worship?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी नई देवता बनी आत्मा उस विवरण के लिखे जाने से लगभग सत्तर वर्ष पहले अस्तित्व में आई बताई जाती है, जिसने एक गाँववाले पर कब्जा करके पूजा की मांग की थी?
e: Patna jile ke lok-dharm me naye devta bhi samay-samay par jude hi rahte the tatha inki ek misal Naika hai. Uske baare me kaha jaata tha ki woh vivran likhe jaane se lagbhag sattar saal pehle astittva me aaya. Uska udgam is tarah bataya jaata hai ki ek gaonwale par koi dushit aatma ka kabza ho gaya; jab ojha ko bulaya gaya, to us aatma ne us vyakti ke muh se bol kar kaha ki woh naya aane wala hai tatha use puja chahiye; yadi use puja nahi mili, to woh poore parivar par bade sankat laayega. Is bhay se us vyakti ke parivar ne us aatma ko devta maan kar puja shuru kar di; samay ke saath yah puja phaili tatha Naika Kandua, Tatwa tatha anya nimn jatiyon ke devta ban gaye. Exam point: Naika naam ki aatma us vivran se lagbhag sattar saal pehle astittva me aayi maani jaati hai; ek gaonwale par kabza hone par ojha bulaye jaane par us aatma ne puja ki maang ki tatha na milne par parivar par sankat laane ki dhamki di; parivar ke puja shuru karne se yah puja phaili tatha Naika Kandua tatha anya nimn jatiyon ke devta ban gaye.

qe: Which spirit of the Patna district was believed to have been originally a skilful lady doctor, invoked by women when administering medicine, with the empty cup placed inverted on the ground?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी आत्मा मूल रूप से कुशल महिला वैद्य मानी जाती थी, जिसे औरतें दवा देते समय पुकारती थीं तथा खाली कटोरा उलटकर ज़मीन पर रख देती थीं?
e: Patna jile ke lok-dharm me ek aisi aatma bhi puji jaati thi jiska rishta dawa-daru se tha. Amasan Bibi ke baare me kaha jaata tha ki woh asal me ek bahut kushal mahila vaidya thi tatha aaj bhi bimar logon ko theek karne ke liye unhe pukara jaata tha. Dawa tatha daru dete samay unka naam lena aam baat thi tatha unki rasm nimn tarah thi - thodi si mitti lekar mareez ke sir ke charon or teen baar ghumaai jaati thi tatha us mitti ko ghar ke ek chhote se kone me rakh diya jaata tha. Jab mareez theek ho jaata, to us mitti ke baraabar tol kar mithai Amasan Bibi ko chadhai jaati thi. Isi tarah gaon me mahamari ke samay ghar ke bahar sharaab ya pani ke chhinte daalne ki riti bhi prachlit thi. Aisi manyataayein dikhati hain ki ilaj tatha dharm ek doosre se alag nahi maane jaate the. Exam point: Amasan Bibi ko asal me kushal mahila vaidya maana jaata tha tatha bimar parivar ki auraten unka naam lekar dawa deti thin; thodi mitti mareez ke sir ke charon or teen baar ghumai jaati thi tatha ghar ke kone me rakhi jaati thi; theek hone par us mitti ke baraabar mithai unhe chadhai jaati thi.

qe: Goraiya, a specially popular godling in the Patna district, is a male hero of Dusadh origin, said to have been what, and he is said to have come from Delhi and died fighting near Sherpur?
qh: पटना जिले का विशेष रूप से लोकप्रिय देव गोरैया दुसाध मूल का पुरुष नायक है, जिसे क्या बताया जाता है तथा कहा जाता है कि वह दिल्ली से आया और शेरपुर के पास लड़ते हुए मारा गया?
e: Patna jile me Goraiya ek bahut lokpriya dev yaani godling maana jaata tha, jiska udgam Dusadh samuday se bataya jaata hai tatha jise ek dakaiton ka sardar yaani bandit chief kaha jaata tha. Uske samman me gaaye jaane wale geeton me usay ek mahan yodha bataya jaata hai, jo Delhi se thode se saathiyon ke saath aaya tatha jile ke Sherpur ke nikat Melhnawan naam ke sthal par ladte hue mara gaya; us jagah aaj bhi uska mukhya mandir maujood hai. Aaj woh poore jile me nimn jatiyon tatha kai anya jatiyon ke logon dwara bhi puja jaata hai, tatha Babhan jaise kai unchi jatiyon ke log bhi uski puja karte hain. Uska chinh aam taur par gaon ke bahar kisi ped ke niche ek patthar ya mitti ka tila hota hai, jahan bakre, mithai, doodh tatha ghi chadha kar unhe baad me Dusadh log utha le jaate hain. Exam point: Goraiya Dusadh mool ka dev tha jise dakaiton ka sardar kaha jaata tha; geeton me usay mahan yodha bataya jaata hai jo Delhi se thode saathiyon ke saath aaya tatha Sherpur ke nikat Melhnawan me ladte hue mara gaya; uska chinh gaon ke bahar ped ke niche patthar ya mitti ka tila hota hai tatha chadhaaya prasad Dusadh log utha le jaate hain.

qe: Which deified hero of the Patna district was a Rajput who lived near Barh in a village where all the other inhabitants were Mallahs, and was killed by them out of envy?
qh: पटना जिले का कौन-सा देवता बना नायक वह राजपूत था जो बाढ़ के निकट एक ऐसे गाँव में रहता था जहाँ अन्य सभी निवासी मल्लाह थे, तथा जिसे ईर्ष्या के कारण उन्होंने मार डाला?
e: Patna jile ke lok-dharm me Goraiya ke alava ek anya devta bana nayak bhi tha, jiska naam Amar Singh tha. Woh ek Rajput the tatha Barh ke nikat ek aise gaon me rahte the, jahan unke alava baaki sabhi nivasi Mallah jati ke the. Kaha jaata hai ki Mallah logon ne unhe sirf eershya ke kaaran maar daala tha; uske baad woh us gaon me bhatakte tatha Mallah logon ko pareshan karte rahte, jab tak ki unlogon ne unhe puja karne ka vachan nahi de diya. Aaj bhi woh poore jile me puja jaate hain tatha unhe prasann karne ke liye pipal ke ped ke niche bakron ki bali di jaati hai, jisme bakre ka sir kisi nadi me phenk diya jaata tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki lok-devtaon ke udgam ki kathayein aksar gaon ke aapas ke jhagdon se judi hoti thin. Exam point: Amar Singh Barh ke nikat ke us gaon me rahte the jahan unke alava sabhi log Mallah jati ke the tatha unhe eershya ke kaaran mara gaya tha; woh gaon me bhatakte tatha Mallah logon ko pareshan karte rahte, tabhi unhone puja karne ka vachan diya; unhe pipal ke ped ke niche bakron ki bali se prasann kiya jaata tha tatha bakre ka sir nadi me phenka jaata tha.

qe: Which custom, adopted by the Hindus of the Patna district from the lower class of Muhammadans, was observed after a marriage or the birth of a child?
qh: पटना जिले के हिंदुओं द्वारा निम्न वर्ग के मुसलमानों से अपनाई गई कौन-सी रस्म विवाह या संतान के जन्म के बाद निभाई जाती थी?
oe: Burial of the dead in a mosque
Launching paper boats on the Ganges in honour of Khwaja Khizr
Tying a thread on the wrist
oh: ख्वाजा खिज़्र के सम्मान में गंगा में कागज़ की नाव चलाना
e: Patna jile me Hindu tatha Mussalman samuday ek doosre ke riti-riwaj se kuch-kuch cheezen lete rahe the, isliye lok-dharm me dono ka mila-jula roop dikhta hai. Iski ek achhi misal yah hai ki kabhi-kabhi Hindu log vivah ya santan ke janm ke baad Ganga me kagaz ki naven chalate the, tatha yah khwaja Khizr ke samman me kiya jaata tha; Khizr ko jal-marg ka rakshak maana jaata tha, isliye nadi se jude maukon par unka naam liya jaata tha. Isi tarah Panch Pir ki puja Barhi ke Kalwar tatha Kahar, Goala, Kandu tatha Kumar jaise nimn jatiyon me prachlit thi. Patna me jine paanch pir puji jaate the, unme do pir aise the jin ke naam Hindu the - Sahaja, jise Mahamaya se joda jaata tha, tatha Ajab Tathile, jise Hanuman ka hi roop maana jaata tha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki gaon ka dharm ek bahut mishrit aitihasik dhaara ka parinaam hai. Exam point: Hindu log vivah ya santan ke janm ke baad Ganga me kagaz ki naven chalate the, jo khwaja Khizr ke samman me hota tha; Panch Pir ki puja Barhi ke Kalwar tatha Kahar, Goala, Kandu tatha Kumar jaisi nimn jatiyon me prachlit thi; Patna me puji jaane wali paanch pir me do Hindu naam ke the - Sahaja yaani Mahamaya tatha Ajab Tathile yaani Hanuman.

qe: Which disease-goddess of the Patna district was propitiated by a piece of ground smeared with cow-dung near the patient, while a Mali sang songs in her honour and the patient was fanned with a twig of the nim tree?
qh: पटना जिले की कौन-सी रोग-देवी को रोगी के पास गोबर से लीपी हुई ज़मीन, माली द्वारा उनके सम्मान में गीत तथा रोगी को नीम की टहनी से हवा करके प्रसन्न किया जाता था?
e: Patna jile ki orthodox Hindu deviyon me Sitala ki puja sabse alag tatha vyapak thi, kyunki chechak yaani smallpox ki bimari ke phailne par sabhi Hindu log Brahman se le kar Dom tak unki puja karte the. Jab koi bimar padta tha, to uske palang ke paas zameen ka thoda hissa gobar se lip diya jaata tha tatha wahan aag jalai jaati thi, jispar ghi daala jaata tha tatha dhup jalai jaati thi. Us samay ek Mali ko bulaya jaata tha, jo Sitala ke samman me geet gata tha, tatha bimar ko mithai khila kar neem ki tehni se hawa di jaati thi, kyunki neem unka manpasand ped maana jaata tha. Is bimari ka yahi ek vyavharik ilaj maana jaata tha; nimn jati ke Hindu tatha Mussalman log apne bachchon ko taika lagwane se bhi darte the, kyunki unhe lagta tha ki isse devi krodhit hongi. Sitala ko haiza yaani cholera ki devi bhi maana jaata tha, isliye mahamari ke samay ghar ke dwar par chhak yaani ilaichi-laung ka pani chhidka jaata tha tatha Brahmanon se unke gun-gaan karane ke liye chanda diya jaata tha. Exam point: chechak ki bimari me Sitala ki puja Brahman se Dom tak sabhi karte the; bimar ke paas gobar se lipi zameen par aag jalai jaati thi jispar ghi tatha dhup daali jaati thi; Mali unke geet gaata tha tatha bimar ko neem ki tehni se hawa di jaati thi; log bachchon ko taika lagwane se darate the tatha haiza ke samay chhak chhidk kar Brahmanon se gun-gaan karate the.

qe: In the khappar processions of the Patna district, in which direction did the village ojhas carry earthen pots with burning incense, crying 'Kali Mai ki tai'?
qh: पटना जिले की खप्पर यात्राओं में गाँव के ओझा जलती धूप वाले मिट्टी के बर्तन लेकर किस दिशा में जाते थे तथा 'काली माई की ताई' का नारा लगाते थे?
e: Patna jile me Kali ki puja sabse lokpriya orthodox devi-puja maani jaati thi; uska mukhya mandir Patna shahar me Kalisthan me, Mangles ke talaab ke paas tha. Devi ke isi roop ki ek anokhi rasm khappar yatra ke naam se prachlit thi. Jab bhi koi mahamari phailti thi, gaon ke ojha yaani jhaad-phook karne wale log mitti ke bartan lekar nikalte the, jinme dhup jalti rehti thi. Unke peeche gaon ke log chalte the tatha sab milkar 'Kali Mai ki tai' yaani Kalimai ki tayi ke nare lagate hue Calcutta ki or badhte the; raste ke pehle gaon me woh jalta hua bartan chhod jaate the, phir us agle gaon ke log us bartan ko lekar aage badhte the. Is tarah yah yatra gaon se gaon tak pahunchti jati thi. Devi ke ek anya roop Bighin Mai, jo Kali ki sahchar mani jaati thi, ki puja mahamari ke samay chaurahon par hoti thi - wahan gaddha khod kar aag jalai jaati thi, mithai rakhi jaati thi tatha dhup jalai jaati thi. Exam point: mahamari ke samay gaon ke ojha jalti dhup wale mitti ke bartan lekar 'Kali Mai ki tai' ke nare ke saath Calcutta ki or badhte the tatha pehle gaon me bartan chhod dete the; Kali ka mukhya mandir Patna shahar me Kalisthan me, Mangles ke talaab ke paas tha; Kali ki sahchar Bighin Mai ki puja chaurahon par gaddha khod kar aag jalane tatha mithai chadhaane se hoti thi.

qe: In the census figures for the Patna district, what proportion of the total population was Hindu and what proportion Muhammadan?
qh: पटना जिले के जनगणना आंकड़ों के अनुसार कुल जनसंख्या का कितना हिस्सा हिंदू तथा कितना मुसलमान था?
oe: About 89 per cent Hindu and about 10 per cent Muhammadan
About 70 per cent Hindu and about 30 per cent Muhammadan
About 95 per cent Hindu and about 3 per cent Muhammadan
About 80 per cent Hindu and about 20 per cent Muhammadan
oh: लगभग 89 प्रतिशत हिंदू तथा लगभग 10 प्रतिशत मुसलमान
लगभग 70 प्रतिशत हिंदू तथा लगभग 30 प्रतिशत मुसलमान
लगभग 95 प्रतिशत हिंदू तथा लगभग 3 प्रतिशत मुसलमान
लगभग 80 प्रतिशत हिंदू तथा लगभग 20 प्रतिशत मुसलमान
e: Patna jile ke dharmik varnan ki shuruat hi jile ki abaadi ke dharmik bantware se hoti hai. Jile ki kul abaadi me lagbhag 89 pratishat log Hindu the tatha lagbhag das pratishat log Muhammadan the; Hindu logon ki sankhya chaudah lakh barah hazaar do sau taintees thi, jabki Mussalmanon ki sankhya ek lakh achpan hazaar chaar sau adtish thi. Is tarah Mussalman ek tulnatmak chhota samuday the, lekin jile ke kai pramukh tatha agrani parivar, khaas taur par Patna shahar me, Mussalman the. Isi jile me Isai yaani Christian logon ki sankhya adtis hazaar ek sau pachhattar thi tatha Jain tatha Sikh dharm ke logon ki sankhya bahut kam thi. Aise aankde dikhate hain ki abaadi ka dharmik dhancha kshetra ke itihas tatha vyapar se kaise juda hua tha. Exam point: Patna jile ki abaadi me lagbhag 89 pratishat Hindu tatha lagbhag das pratishat Muhammadan the; Mussalmanon ki sankhya ek lakh achpan hazaar chaar sau adtish thi tatha ve tulnatmak roop se chhota samuday the, lekin jile ke kai pramukh parivar, khaas taur par Patna shahar me, Mussalman the; Isai logon ki sankhya adtis hazaar ek sau pachhattar thi tatha Jain tatha Sikh bahut kam the.

qe: Why is the history of religion in the Patna district of special interest?
qh: पटना जिले के धर्म का इतिहास विशेष रूप से महत्वपूर्ण क्यों माना जाता है?
oe: Because the district was the early home both of Buddhism and of Jainism
Because it was the birthplace of Sikhism
Because it was the home of the Bhakti movement
Because it was the first Christian diocese
oh: क्योंकि यह जिला बौद्ध धर्म तथा जैन धर्म, दोनों का आरंभिक केंद्र रहा
क्योंकि यह सिख धर्म का जन्मस्थान था
क्योंकि यह भक्ति आंदोलन का केंद्र था
क्योंकि यह पहला ईसाई धर्मप्रांत था
e: Patna jile ke dharmik itihas ka apna khaas mahatva bataya jaata hai. Iska mukhya karan yah hai ki yah jila Bauddh dharm tatha Jain dharm dono ka shuruaati ghar tatha kendra raha. Bhagwan Buddha ka jeevan ka bada hissa Rajgir me bita tatha Patna kshetra hi woh jagah thi jahan se Bauddh vidya tatha Bauddh dharm-pracharak door-door tak Asia ke deshon me pahunche. Isi jile ne Jain dharm ka uday tatha vikas bhi dekha; isi kshetra se chauthi sadi ee. poo. me Jain panth poore bharat me phaila tatha aaj bhi us dharm ke tirth sthal yahan yatro ko khinchte hain. Isi shahar me Sikh dharm ke mahan neta Guru Gobind Singh ka janm hua tatha yahi us daur me Hindustan ke sabse puraane Isai mission ka bhi mukhyalay raha. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki ek hi kshetra kai dharmik paramparaon ka sakshi raha. Exam point: Patna jila Bauddh tatha Jain dharm dono ka shuruaati ghar raha; Bhagwan Buddha ka jeevan ka bada hissa Rajgir me bita tatha isi kshetra se Bauddh pracharak Asia ke door deshon tak pahunche; chauthi sadi ee. poo. me Jain panth isi kshetra se bharat bhar me phaila tatha yahi shahar Guru Gobind Singh ka janm sthal tatha Hindustan ke ek puraane Isai mission ka mukhyalay raha.

qe: In the Patna district, which ancient religion began to spread over India in the fourth century BC from this very area?
qh: पटना जिले में चौथी सदी ईसा पूर्व में इसी क्षेत्र से कौन-सा प्राचीन धर्म भारत भर में फैलना शुरू हुआ?
e: Patna kshetra Jain dharm ke uday tatha vikas ka bada kendra raha. Jain dharm ke sansthapak Mahavira ka dehant Pawapuri me hua, jo isi kshetra me hai. Isi jile se chauthi sadi isa poorv me Jain panth poore bharat me phailne laga. Aaj Jain dharm ke anuyayi bahut kam sankhya me hain, lekin is dharm ke janm-sthal ke pavitra tirth sthal abhi bhi desh ke kone-kone se yatriyon ko apni or khinchte hain. Isi tarah Bauddh dharm ka prabhav samay ke saath kam ho gaya, lekin uske asar ke nishan aaj bhi kuch lok-andhvishwaso tatha puraani ritiyon me dikhai dete hain. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki dharm ke badalne ke bawajood uske nishan lambe samay tak samajik tatha dharmik jeevan me bane rahte hain. Exam point: Patna kshetra se chauthi sadi isa poorv me Jain panth poore bharat me phailne laga; Mahavira ka dehant isi kshetra ke Pawapuri me hua; aaj Jain anuyayi kam hain, lekin unke tirth sthal desh bhar se yatriyon ko khinchte hain; Bauddh dharm ka prabhav kam hote hue bhi uske nishan kuch lok-andhvishwaso me bache hue hain.

qe: Which city in the Patna district was the headquarters of one of the earliest Christian Missions in Hindustan?
qh: पटना जिले का कौन-सा नगर हिंदुस्तान के सबसे पुराने ईसाई मिशनों में से एक का मुख्यालय था?
e: Patna shahar ka dharmik itihas kai paramparaon ka sangam maana jaata hai. Yahi shahar Bauddh dharm ka kendra raha, yahin Jain dharm ke tirth sthal bane tatha yahi Sikh dharm ke mahan neta Guru Gobind Singh ka janm sthal hai. Isi ke saath yah shahar Hindustan ke sabse puraane Isai missionon me se ek ka mukhyalay bhi raha tatha baad me Wahabi prachar ka bhi kendra bana. In sabhi dharmik andolanon ke beech jile ki bahusankhyak Hindu abaadi apne vishwas tatha puraani lok-ritiyon ke saath badi hui. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki Patna ek aisa shahar tha jahan ek hi jagah par kai dharmik dhaaraayein, kuch puraani tatha kuch nayi, saath-saath chalti rahin. Exam point: Patna shahar Hindustan ke sabse puraane Isai missionon me se ek ka mukhyalay raha tatha baad me Wahabi prachar ka kendra bhi bana; yahi shahar Guru Gobind Singh ka janm sthal hai tatha Bauddh tatha Jain paramparaon ka bhi kendra raha; in sab ke beech jile ki bahusankhyak Hindu abaadi apni lok-ritiyon ke saath badhi.

qe: What did the great majority of the Hindus of the Patna district, described as uneducated men of low caste, know of the higher religion?
qh: पटना जिले के अधिकांश हिंदू, जिन्हें अशिक्षित निम्न जाति के लोग बताया गया है, उच्च धर्म के बारे में क्या जानते थे?
oe: They followed only the Sanskrit scriptures
They were trained in temple rituals
Very little, and their worship was mixed with many primitive superstitions and quaint observances
They followed only the Jain customs
oh: वे केवल संस्कृत शास्त्रों का पालन करते थे
उन्हें मंदिर की रीति में प्रशिक्षित किया जाता था
बहुत कम, तथा उनकी पूजा में अनेक आदिम अंधविश्वास तथा अनोखी रस्में मिली हुई थीं
वे केवल जैन रीति-रिवाजों का पालन करते थे
e: Patna jile ke dharmik varnan me yah saaf likha milta hai ki jile ke adhiktar Hindu log ashikshit the tatha unme bahut se nimn jati ke log shamil the, isliye uccha tatha shastriy dharm ka gyaan unhe bahut kam tha. Unki puja tatha vishwas aise the jisme kai tarah ke purane tatha ajib lok-ritiyon tatha andhvishwaso ki chhaya thi. Isi kaaran gaon ke jeevan me devi-devtaon tatha prem-yaani dushit aatmaon ki puja, bali tatha jhaad-phook jaise tareeke saath-saath chalte the. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki us daur ke dharm ke do roop the - ek shastriy tatha doosra lok-dharm, aur aam janata ka jeevan doosre se zyada juda hua tha. Exam point: Patna jile ke adhiktar Hindu ashikshit tatha bahut se nimn jati ke log the, isliye uccha shastriy dharm ka gyaan unhe bahut kam tha; unki puja tatha vishwas bahut se purane tatha ajib lok-ritiyon tatha andhvishwaso se mile hue the; us daur ke dharm ke do roop - shastriy tatha lok-dharm - saath-saath chalte the.

qe: Among the leading families of the Patna district, especially in Patna city, members of which community were particularly prominent?
qh: पटना जिले के प्रमुख परिवारों में, विशेष रूप से पटना नगर में, किस समुदाय के लोग विशेष रूप से प्रमुख थे?
e: Patna jile ki abaadi me Mussalman logon ki sankhya tulnatmak roop se kam thi, lekin unka samajik tatha aarthik prabhav is sankhya se badhkar tha. Yah baat khaas taur par is liye mahatvapurn hai ki jile ke kai pramukh tatha agrani parivar, khaas taur par Patna shahar me, Mussalman the. Usi samay jile me Isai logon ki sankhya bhi theek-thak thi, jabki Jain tatha Sikh dharm ke log bahut kam the. Shahar me Urdu bhasha tatha Persian lipi ka prachalan bhi isi samuday ke kaaran tha, tatha shahar ke vyapar tatha prashasan me unki bhumika bani rahi. Aise aankde dikhate hain ki kisi samuday ki sankhya kam hone ka arth yah nahi hota ki uska prabhav bhi kam tha. Exam point: Patna jile me Mussalman logon ki sankhya kam thi, lekin jile ke kai pramukh tatha agrani parivar, khaas taur par Patna shahar me, Mussalman the; jile me Isai logon ki sankhya bhi theek-thak thi tatha Jain tatha Sikh bahut kam the; shahar me Urdu tatha Persian lipi ka prachalan isi samuday ke kaaran tha.

qe: Which small sect of the Patna district, founded about two centuries earlier by a Rajput named Sheo Narayan of Ghazipur, believed in one formless God and forbade idolatry?
qh: पटना जिले का कौन-सा छोटा संप्रदाय, लगभग दो शताब्दी पूर्व ग़ाज़ीपुर के शिव नारायण नामक राजपूत द्वारा स्थापित, एक निराकार ईश्वर में विश्वास करता था तथा मूर्तिपूजा का निषेध करता था?
e: Patna jile me do chhote sampraday vishesh roop se jane jaate the - Sheo Narayani tatha Kaul. Sheo Narayani sampraday ki sthapna lagbhag do shatabdi pehle Ghazipur ke ek Rajput Sheo Narayan ne ki thi. Yah sampraday ek nirakar Ishwar me vishwas karta tha, yaani kisi murti ko Ishwar nahi maanta tha, isliye yah murtipuja ka nishedh karta tha. Sadasy apne mool Guru ko Ishwar ka avatar maan kar unki puja karte the tatha unka apna pavitra granth tha, jisme nitik updesh tatha Guru ki shikshaon ka sankalan tha. Us granth me kaha gaya hai ki mukti keval Ishwar me atal vishwas, kaam-vikaaron par niyantran tatha Guru ki aagya palan se milti hai. Exam point: Sheo Narayani sampraday lagbhag do shatabdi pehle Ghazipur ke Rajput Sheo Narayan ne banaya; yah ek nirakar Ishwar ko maanta tha, murtipuja mana karta tha tatha mool Guru ko Ishwar ka avatar maanta tha.

qe: The Sheo Narayanis assembled in the house of one of their members, sang songs and read extracts from their sacred book at their great annual festival, held on which night?
qh: शिव नारायणी अपने सबसे बड़े वार्षिक उत्सव पर संप्रदाय के ही किसी सदस्य के घर इकट्ठे होकर गीत गाते तथा अपने पवित्र ग्रंथ के अंश पढ़ते थे; यह उत्सव किस रात को होता था?
oe: The first night of the month of Chaitra
The night of the full moon of Kartik
The fifth night after the new moon of Magh
The eighth night of the dark half of Bhadrapad
oh: माघ की अमावस्या के बाद पाँचवीं रात
भाद्रपद के कृष्ण पक्ष की आठवीं रात
e: Sheo Narayani sampraday ka sabse bada varshik utsav Magh mahine ki amavasya ke baad paanchvin raat ko hota tha. Amavasya ka matlab hai woh raat jab chand dikhai nahi deta; Magh ka mahina jad ke mausam me aata hai. Us raat sadasy kisi ek sadasya ke ghar ikatthe hote the, sangeet ke saath geet gaate the tatha apne pavitra granth ke ansh padhte the. Naye sadasya ko samuday me lene ke liye koi aisa vyakti chuna jaata tha jiski jati uski apni jati se neechi na ho; woh use mantra-diksha deta tha tatha Bhagwan tatha mool Guru me vishwas rakhne ka updesh deta tha. Uske baad sabhi sadasyon ke naam tatha pate likh kar ek praman-patra diya jaata tha. Exam point: Sheo Narayani samuday ka varshik utsav Magh ki amavasya ke baad paanchvin raat ko hota tha, jisme ek sadasya ke ghar ikattha hokar geet tatha granth-path hota tha; naye sadasya ko diksha ke baad praman-patra diya jaata tha.

qe: For the Sheo Narayanis of the Patna district, what practice was one of the great inducements to join the sect, promising that a comrade's body would not be left to be touched by sweepers?
qh: पटना जिले के शिव नारायणियों के लिए संप्रदाय में शामिल होने का एक बड़ा प्रलोभन कौन-सी प्रथा थी, जिससे भरोसा मिलता था कि साथी का शरीर भंगियों के स्पर्श में नहीं जाएगा?
oe: The dead were thrown into the Ganges
The dead of the sect were buried by fellow members
The dead were cremated with Vedic rites
The dead were buried only by Brahman priests
oh: मृतकों को गंगा में प्रवाहित किया जाता था
संप्रदाय के मृतकों को साथी सदस्य मिट्टी में दफ़नाते थे
मृतकों का वैदिक विधि से दाह-संस्कार होता था
मृतकों को केवल ब्राह्मण पुरोहित दफ़नाते थे
e: Sheo Narayani apne murdon ka dah-sanskar nahi karte the, balki unhe mitti me dafnate the. Is samuday me shamil hone ka ek bada kaaran yah tha ki sadasyata lene wale ko yah bharosa mil jaata tha ki uski mrityu ke baad uske saathi uske shareer ki izzat ke saath dafan karenge tatha kisi bhangi ya safai-karmi ko uske shareer ko chhune ki zaroorat nahi padegi. Unnati ke dinon me isi baat ko logon ke saamne rakh kar unhe samuday me joda jaata tha. Sadharan jati ke niyam is samuday me bhi maane jaate the, sirf un logon ko chhoot thi jo mahatma ya sanyasi jaisa jeevan apna lete the. Is jile me Sheo Narayani zyadatar nimn jatiyon me hi bache the tatha unki sankhya ghat rahi thi; Patna shahar me Chasgiar yaani chamda ka kaam karne wale logon ki ek achhi basti thi, baaki Dusadh tatha Mallah the tatha kuch Kurmi tatha Kandu bhi the. Exam point: Sheo Narayani samuday me mrityu ke baad dah nahi, dafan hota tha; saathi sadasya ise samman ke saath dafnate the, isliye safai-karmion ki chhoot ka bharosa samuday me shamil hone ka bada pralobhan tha.

qe: The Kaul of the Patna district held that five things were essential in their night worship; in practice, which of these was taken to mean a round-shaped edible such as a laddu, puri or kachauri?
qh: पटना जिले के कौल अपनी रात्रि-पूजा में पाँच वस्तुओं को अनिवार्य मानते थे; व्यवहार में इनमें से किसका अर्थ लड्डू, पूरी या कचौड़ी जैसी गोल आकार की खाद्य वस्तु लिया जाता था?
oe: The mystical gesture of the fingers called mudra
oh: अँगुलियों का रहस्यमय संकेत, जिसे मुद्रा कहते थे
e: Kaul Saktism ki ek shakha thi, yaani devi-shakti ki upasana karne wala sampraday. Iska mukhya siddhant yah tha ki sab kuch ek hi sarvavyapak chetna ka roop hai tatha sansar me kuch bhi ashuddh nahi hota. Isi vichar ke aadhar par Kaul jati-bhed ko maante nahi the, lekin yeh niyam sirf sampraday ki sabha tak simit tha; sabha ke bahar har vyakti apni jati me hi gina jaata tha. Unki puja raat me hoti thi tatha usme paanch vastuayein zaroori maani jaati thin - machhli, mans, madira, mudra tatha stri-purush sambandh. Vyavahar me chauthi vastu, yaani mudra ka arth gul gol aakar ki khaady cheez - laddu, puri ya kachauri - liya jaata tha, isliye asli shabdaarth ke bajaye prateek ka prayog hota tha. Puja me purohit Brahman hi hota tha tatha maathe par sirf Kali ke upasak jaisa gol sindur ka teeka lagaya jaata tha. Exam point: Kaul sampraday raat me paanch vastuayein - machhli, mans, madira, mudra tatha stri-purush sambandh - zaroori maanta tha; vyavahar me mudra ka arth laddu, puri ya kachauri jaisi gol khaady vastu liya jaata tha tatha sabha ke bahar har vyakti apni jati me hi rahta tha.

qe: In the Kaul worship of the Patna district, which auxiliary spell, acting as an armour for the reciter, protected him from any harm caused by a mistake or misquotation in a mantra?
qh: पटना जिले की कौल-पूजा में कौन-सा सहायक मंत्र पाठ करने वाले के लिए कवच की तरह काम करता था, जो मंत्र के ग़लत पाठ या भूल से होने वाली हानि से बचाता था?
e: Kaul sadhna me mool mantra ke path ke saath ya uske aage teen tarah ke sahayak mantra prayog hote the - kil, kawach tatha argala. Inhe sahayak mantra kaha ja sakta hai, jo mool mantra ke path ko prabhavi banane ya uske kisi galat ucharan se banne wali hani se bachane ke liye lagaye jaate the. Kil tatha argala ka shabdik arth 'keel' tatha 'chitkani' hota hai; inhe purane samay ka sadhan maana jaata tha, jo granthon me likhi baaton ki shakti ko, jaise taale ko khole, waisa kar dete the. Kawach ka arth 'kavach' yaani armour hota hai, jo mantra ke galat prayog se raksha karta tha. Yahi kawach-shabd aaj bhi raksha-kavach ke arth me prachalit hai. Exam point: Kaul upasak mantra-path se pehle kil, kawach tatha argala naam ke sahayak mantra lagate the; kil tatha argala mantra ki shakti ko kholte the tatha kawach, jiska arth kavach hai, galat path ki hani se raksha karta tha.

qe: About 1850, which Pandit from Benares gave a great impetus to the Kaul sect in Patna City?
qh: लगभग 1850 में बनारस के किस पंडित ने पटना सिटी में कौल संप्रदाय को बड़ा बल दिया?
e: Kaul sampraday Patna me pehle se tha, lekin lagbhag 1850 me Benares ke Pandit Subhankar Misr ne Patna City me is sampraday ko bahut bada bal diya. Unke aane ke baad is sampraday ke anuyayiyon ki sankhya kuch samay ke liye badhi, lekin baad me yah sampraday patan ki or badhta gaya. Is sampraday me guptata ek niyam thi, isliye iske sadasyon ki asli sankhya kabhi pakki tarah nahi batayi ja saki. Kaul logon ka puja-vidhan raat me hota tha tatha unke mantra-path me kil, kawach tatha argala jaise sahayak mantra bhi shamil the. Is tarah ke sampraday us samay ke samaj me bhakti tatha tantra dono dhaaraon ka mel dikhate hain. Exam point: lagbhag 1850 me Benares ke Pandit Subhankar Misr ne Patna City me Kaul sampraday ko bada bal diya; guptata ke niyam ke kaaran uski sadasya-sankhya ka pukhta aakda nahi milta tatha aage chalkar yah sampraday patan par gaya.
